basis: Independent teaching assumptions, not manufacturer data; no experimental calibration or validation
scope: Seven spatial layers plus seven lumped chip packages. Each spatial layer has one temperature through its thickness. Closed-product external losses on display, back glass and outer frame only. Internal air gaps use conduction plus a fixed linearized radiative conductance; no air-flow solve. PCB holes retained; USB slot omitted in the homogenized frame. Adhesive, mounts, pedestal, TIM and RF posts collapsed into massless conductances. BMS, connectors, passives, camera, speaker, haptic and optional top bridge are omitted from the thermal network. The existing full CAD remains context; omitted solids stay gray.

rf_pad.basis: Illustrative compressed pad, not a selected commercial product; pressure, compression mechanics and temperature dependence are unresolved

comparison: Before = frozen Stage 03 combined case, no pad. After = same 2 W battery + 1.75 W electronics, 25 C ambient, exterior losses, timing, geometry and contacts, except the RF pad replaces its footprint of the air/radiation gap. Pad mass and internal conduction are added. The three source cases below are also run internally for source-superposition verification; the published comparison uses combined heat in both configurations.
